translation_category: deliberately designed systematic emulation of selected concepts
timezone: UTC; Silver Bullet session uses America/New_York with DST
reserved_policy: Do not fetch, inspect or evaluate September 2026 onward in this campaign. Previously exposed development and published-source windows are not pristine holdouts. A final forward/untouched test requires a separately frozen finalist contract.
screen_rationale: Reject cost-fragile, sparse or recent-regime-dependent prototypes using the previous campaign's fixed screen, without weakening it after seeing results. Both recent base folds positive, recent combined stress return positive, overall closed-trade PF at least 1.05 and each fold close DD at most 10%. This is preliminary research rejection, not a statistical edge or deployment test.
ranking: Eligible candidates first, then greatest worst annual net return, then greatest mean annual return; publish failures and controls. No qualifying candidate means RETURN_TO_PHASE_1, no selected baseline and no tuning.
chronology: 2022-2024 historical development; 2025 and Jan-Aug 2026 reused chronological validation/screening, not untouched out-of-sample. Annual portfolios reset; indicators may observe earlier completed candles, signals must occur inside the fold. No prior-year positions or last-close intents transfer across folds.
cost_rationale: Research assumptions of 6 bps taker fee and 2 bps adverse slippage per fill, 4 bps stress slippage; not an authenticated account quote. Signed historical funding retains existing verified opening-mark proxies and 1% adverse funding payment buffer.
limitations: Original Python designs use published concepts, with explicit adaptations; no claim to reproduce discretionary ICT judgment, detect actual institutional orders or copy licensed indicator code.
Silver Bullet uses only 5m because source guidance requires below 15m. No other timeframe or venue is supported by this comparison.
Closed-bar confirmation followed by next-open market execution replaces unproven midpoint limit fills. Targets are market-on-trigger proxies; dual-touch bars use adverse stop-first ordering.
One position, no pyramiding/reversal; 0.25% nominal modeled stop risk and maximum 1x entry exposure. Gaps and funding can exceed nominal stop risk.
All trades time out after 180 minutes; BTC trades 24/7, so positions may cross a UTC date boundary. No calendar-midnight flattening is asserted.
Annual folds reset capital and censor remaining positions at marked equity rather than inventing a terminal fill. Summed fold returns are not a compounded portfolio return.
Historical venue-filter changes, latency, partial fills, liquidation, exact settlement marks and broker reconciliation remain unverified.
Prior 18-candidate failed comparison and published-model selection count as research exposure; this 15-context comparison is not an independent statistical confirmation.
Python research only: no UI registration, Pine/TradingView acceptance, optimization, paper adapter, live account connection or orders.
